LanguageData.PhobosCombatExtendedPatches_SettingKeepG: Colonists go back to their own guns (recommended)

On (the default): a colonist left holding a grenade or a satchel charge, or holding nothing after being downed, takes their own gun up again. First a gun in their pack that can fire, then the gun they dropped when they went down, wherever it lies, even if forbidden. Drafted colonists are left to your orders, and a colonist holding a melee weapon is left alone. Off: Combat Extended and the game work as their authors wrote them. Takes effect at once; no restart needed.
LanguageData.PhobosCombatExtendedPatches_SettingFetch: When their own gun is gone, take another of the same kind

On (the default): if the gun a colonist dropped when downed was destroyed or left behind, or they are holding a grenade and have no gun at all, they take the nearest gun of the same kind as the one they last held, if one lies unforbidden on the map with rounds in it. They never take a different kind of gun. Off: they only go back to the gun that was theirs.
LanguageData.PhobosCombatExtendedPatches_SettingFixSi: Simple Sidearms keeps a colonist's gun, not a grenade, as the weapon it hands back (recommended)

On (the default), with Simple Sidearms active: when a colonist holds a gun and Simple Sidearms has a grenade, or nothing, as the ranged weapon it keeps putting back in their hands, the gun takes that place, just as if they had picked it up themselves. A different gun you chose in Simple Sidearms is left alone, and so is a weapon you forced there. Off: Simple Sidearms works as its author wrote it. Does nothing without Simple Sidearms.
LanguageData.PhobosCombatExtendedPatches_KeepGunsWhy: Why this exists: with Combat Extended, a colonist downed in a fight drops their gun on the ground. When they get up, a grenade from their pack goes into their empty hands first, and the game forgets the gun it would have sent them back for. Simple Sidearms then remembers the grenade as their favourite ranged weapon, and their loadout counts the grenade as their weapon, so they never look for a gun again. If a colonist has no gun at all, hand them one once: they keep it from then on.
LanguageData.PhobosCombatExtendedPatches_KeepGunsOffW: Off: colonists who were downed can end up fighting with only grenades and satchel charges, until you hand them a gun.
